text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down modestly over the past day, with Ethereum underperforming slightly, suggesting selective profit-taking rather than panic selling. The Fear & Greed index sits in greed territory at 73 but has declined 5 points over a week, signaling confidence is cooling from recent peaks. BTC dominance at 58.4% and a solid $136B in daily volume indicate the market retains healthy participation across altcoins despite the minor pullback.
